test_title: PYST 22: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 07 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All c are f.

No f is t.

All p are c.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some t are c.

II. No p is t.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Either conclusion I or II follows.

solution: Statements: All c are f. No f is t. All p are c. **Venn diagram:** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/162c0a3624adc74ef005fd4e9699eaeae650658d58f3d54a9ffe496fc8867db2.png]
